AGGREGATECAPACITYAVAILABLE.description: Sum of MAXAVAIL quantities offered by all Scheduled units and Availability of all semi-scheduled units limited by MAXAVAIL in a given Region for a given PERIODID

AGGREGATEPASAAVAILABILITY.description: Sum of PASAAVAILABILITY for all scheduled generating units and scheduled bidirectional units (Gen side) with a Recall_Period <= 24 hours plus the sum of Unconstrained Intermittent Generation Forecasts (UIGF) for all semi-scheduled generating units. For the RELIABILITY_LRC and OUTAGE_LRC runs, UIGF is the POE90 forecast. For the LOR Run, UIGF is the POE50 forecast. Note that the RELIABILITY_LRC and OUTAGE_LRC Run Types are discontinued from 31 July 2025. From March 2026, AGGREGATEPASAAVAILABILITY changes from that with Recall_Period <= 24 to that achievable by the relevant INTERVAL_DATETIME if recalled at the start of the run.

AGGREGATESCHEDULEDLOAD.description: Sum of  MAXAVAIL quantities bid by of all Scheduled Loads in a given Region for a given PERIODID.

CALCULATEDLOR1LEVEL.description: Region Reserve Level for LOR1 used. Can be static value or calculated value if an interconnector is a credible contingency

CALCULATEDLOR2LEVEL.description: Region Reserve Level for LOR2 used. Can be static value or calculated value if an interconnector is a credible contingency

CAPACITYREQ.description: Demand + Reserve requirements (MW). This field is not populated after 30 July 2025.

CONSTRAINEDCAPACITY.description: Aggregate generation + WDR capacity from Energy Constrained plant subjected to restrictions due to network constraints.

DEMAND_AND_NONSCHEDGEN.description: Sum of Cleared Scheduled generation, imported generation (at the region boundary) and allowances made for non-scheduled generation (MW).

ENERGYREQDEMAND10.description: Energy (GWh) required for this energy block based on the 10% probability of exceedance demand. Listed in the first interval of the energy block

ENERGYREQDEMAND50.description: Sum of: (Region Demand50)/Period (sum by trading day, entered in first period of trading day, GWh).

FUM.description: Forecasting Uncertainty Measure. MW value of reserve calculated as defined in the Reserve Level Declaration Guidelines

INTERVAL_DATETIME.description: End date time of the interval.

LASTCHANGED.description: Date time this record was created.

LCR.description: Largest Credible Risk. MW value for highest credible contingency

LCR2.description: Two Largest Credible Risks. MW value for highest two credible contingencies.

LORCONDITION.description: The LOR Condition determined from the Maximum Spare Capacity value: 0 - no condition, 1 - LOR1 condition, 2 - LOR2 condition, 3 - LOR3 condition

LORNETINTERCHANGEUNDERSCARCITY.description: Net interconnector flow from the region for this interval from the LOR assessment

LOR_SEMISCHEDULEDCAPACITY.description: Constrained generation forecast for semi-scheduled units for the region for the LOR run. Semi-scheduled generation is constrained by both System Normal and Outage constraints, and incorporate MAXAVAIL limits.

MAXSPARECAPACITY.description: Maximum Spare Capacity (MW) evaluated for this region. Calculated for each region in turn. This value reflects Regional LOR reserve.

MAXSURPLUSRESERVE.description: Maximum Surplus Reserve (MW) evaluated for this region from LRC runs. This field is no longer populated.

MSRNETINTERCHANGEUNDERSCARCITY.description: Net interconnector flow from the region for this interval from the MSR assessment. This field is no longer populated.

NETINTERCHANGEUNDERSCARCITY.description: Net export (MW) out of this region in the LOR evaluation. Export if > 0, Import if < 0. This value is the same as LORNETINTERCHANGEUNDERSCARCITY.

RESERVECONDITION.description: Regional reserve condition from LRC run. This field is not populated after 30 July 2025.

RESERVEREQ.description: Reserve Requirement (MW). This field is not populated after 30 July 2025.

RUNTYPE.description: Type of run. Values are RELIABILITY_LRC, OUTAGE_LRC and LOR. Note that the STPASA RELIABILITY_LRC and OUTAGE_LRC Run Types are discontinued from 31 July 2025, with only the LOR Run Type reported.

RUN_DATETIME.description: Unique Timestamp Identifier for this run, identified by the nominal start time of the run.

SEMISCHEDULEDCAPACITY.description: Constrained generation forecast (MW) for semi-scheduled units for the region. For RELIABILITY_LRC run, semi-scheduled generation is constrained only by System Normal constraints. For OUTAGE_LRC run and LOR run, semi-scheduled generation is constrained by both System Normal and Outage constraints. All three run types (RELIABILITY_LRC, OUTAGE_LRC, LOR) incorporate MAXAVAIL limits.

SS_SOLAR_CAPACITY.description: Constrained generation forecast for solar for the region. For RELIABILITY_LRC run solar generation is constrained only by System Normal constraints. For OUTAGE_LRC run and LOR run solar generation is constrained by both System Normal and Outage constraints. All three run types (RELIABILITY_LRC, OUTAGE_LRC, LOR) incorporate MAXAVAIL limits.

SS_SOLAR_CLEARED.description: Constrained generation forecast (MW) for solar for the region. For RELIABILITY_LRC run, solar generation is constrained only by System Normal constraints. For OUTAGE_LRC run and LOR run, solar generation is constrained by both System Normal and Outage constraints. All three run types (RELIABILITY_LRC, OUTAGE_LRC, LOR) incorporate MAXAVAIL limits.This value is the same as SS_SOLAR_CAPACITY.

SS_SOLAR_UIGF.description: Unconstrained Intermittent Generation Forecast for solar for the region. For RELIABILITY_LRC and OUTAGE_LRC run this is the POE90 forecast (determined by LRCUIGFOption in CaseSolution). For LOR run this is the POE50 forecast

SS_WIND_CAPACITY.description: Constrained generation forecast for wind for the region. For RELIABILITY_LRC run wind generation is constrained only by System Normal constraints. For OUTAGE_LRC run and LOR run wind generation is constrained by both System Normal and Outage constraints. All three run types (RELIABILITY_LRC, OUTAGE_LRC, LOR) incorporate MAXAVAIL limits.

SS_WIND_CLEARED.description: Constrained generation forecast (MW) for wind for the region. For RELIABILITY_LRC run, wind generation is constrained only by System Normal constraints. For OUTAGE_LRC run and LOR run, wind generation is constrained by both System Normal and Outage constraints. All three run types (RELIABILITY_LRC, OUTAGE_LRC, LOR) incorporate MAXAVAIL limits.This value is the same as SS_WIND_CAPACITY.

SS_WIND_UIGF.description: Unconstrained Intermittent Generation Forecast for wind for the region. For RELIABILITY_LRC and OUTAGE_LRC run this is the POE90 forecast (determined by LRCUIGFOption in CaseSolution). For LOR run this is the POE50 forecast

SURPLUSCAPACITY.description: Regional surplus capacity (MW), +/- values indicate surplus/deficit capacity respectively. This value reflects Regional LOR reserve.

SURPLUSRESERVE.description: Regional surplus reserve (MW). This value also reflects Regional LOR reserve. Note: For LOR runs, RESERVEREQ requirement input is not used.

TOTALINTERMITTENTGENERATION.description: Allowance made for non-scheduled generation in the demand forecast (MW).

UIGF.description: Regional aggregated Unconstrained Intermittent Generation Forecast of Semi-scheduled generation (MW).

UNCONSTRAINEDCAPACITY.description: Aggregate generation + WDR capacity from Non-Energy Constrained plant subjected to restrictions due to network constraints.

WDR_AVAILABLE.description: Regional aggregated Wholesale Demand Response (WDR) availability in MW.

WDR_CAPACITY.description: Regional aggregated Wholesale Demand Response (WDR) capacity in MW.

WDR_PASAAVAILABLE.description: Regional aggregated Wholesale Demand Response (WDR) PASA availability in MW.
